text:
sasha_sales: FYI Prospect Orbitary asked us to validate perf for their conversational checkout flow. Requirements: sustain 250 qps, handle short spikes to 720 qps for 15-25s, and p95 < 200ms for interactive replies. They want a two-page runbook, quick cost delta hosted vs dedicated, and a short security appendix.
omar_se: Got it. Do we have their sample prompt set and average token counts? that'll affect batching and GPU memory.
maya_perf: They uploaded a sample: median prompt ~50 tokens, median reply ~160 tokens -> ~210 tokens total. Traffic mix ~65% short chat, 35% long completions. Model requested: community 70B quant-8.
omar_se: Proposed experiment: 1) warmup 5m @30% target qps; 2) steady 30m @250 qps; 3) burst matrix: three bursts at 450/600/720 qps, 20s each, 90s spacing; 4) cross-AZ fallback: 10% traffic for 10m to fallback region. Record p50/p95/p99, GPU util, batch sizes, queue lengths, and sampled traces.
sasha_sales: Include prewarm guidance and how to showcase KV-cache benefits; they care about cold-start tail.
maya_perf: Prewarm: prime KV with ~1500 representative prefixes and run a 10m low-rate fill to warm kernels and caches. For Dedicated suggest 10% warm standby; for Hosted recommend keeping 2 warm workers during demo.
keith_ops: Sizing note: with quant-8 and KV caching, 250 sustained ~5 A100-equivalent GPUs with efficient batching, 8 GPUs provide safe headroom for 720 qps bursts. Hosted estimate: same peak but unit cost ~1.7-2x due to autoscale overheads. Autoscale cooldown 60s to reduce oscillation.
omar_se: We'll measure with KV on/off and quant=8 vs quant=16 to produce a cost/latency tradeoff chart. Sampling traces at 0.5% for debugging.
ellie_sec: Security asks surfaced: SAML SSO, KMS for keys, audit logs retention 90d, and confirmation of encryption in transit & at rest. If demo uses customer data we need signed DPA and KMS key exchange. For demo data Hosted is fine.
sasha_sales: They asked for a 1M requests/month ballpark cost (avg 210 tokens). Can we rough that quickly?
keith_ops: Quick ballpark: Hosted inference-only ~ $4.0k/mo (depends on token pricing & burst billing). Small Dedicated reserved amortized ~$2.8k/mo + infra ops. We'll produce a cleaner table after run.
maya_perf: Loadgen snippet we'll use (wrk + lua):
```
w rk -t14 -c420 -d20s -R720 --script=chat_mix.lua --latency ${TARGET_HOST}
```
Steady-state run: -R250 for 30m. Include x-rw-trace header for token accounting.
infra-bot: perf job #7777 queued: build OK, scripts uploaded.
omar_se: Timeline: Orbitary wants results by Tuesday EOD. Can we do an internal dry-run tomorrow and customer-facing run Friday?
maya_perf: I can run dry-run tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need access to the sample corpus and a test API key matching the model variant.
ellie_sec: Reminder: before any run with their production data we need DPA and KMS; please route any key exchange through security. I'll attach the exact contract language.
keith_ops: I'll provision the test cluster: 8 x A10g-equivalent in us-west1, logs to secure bucket, network instrumentation enabled; creds to vault. Autoscaler set with 60s cooldown.
infra-bot: perf job #7777 completed: results uploaded to secure storage.
maya_perf: Dry-run summary: steady 250 qps -> p95=188ms, p99=410ms. Burst 720 qps 20s -> p95 peaked 495ms, p99 ~1.15s. KV-cache disabled -> steady p95 increased ~30%. GPU util avg 80% sustained, spike to 99% during bursts. Charts & CSVs in secure link.
omar_se: Solid. Add a targeted run with batch_wait_ms=512 to show latency improvement at the cost of throughput.
sasha_sales: Action items: 1) I will confirm DPA status & upload final corpus (EOD today). 2) keith will confirm infra and snapshot configs by 07:30 PT tomorrow. 3) maya will post full slides + one-pager after dry-run. 4) ellie to prepare security appendix and required SSO/KMS artifacts.
ellie_sec: Will prepare checklist and attach the DPA/KMS snippet; will also list audit retention add-on pricing.
maya_perf: I'll draft one-pager + short slide deck (p95/p99 over time, GPU util heatmap, batch distribution, knobs to toggle, and cost appendix hosted vs dedicated).
keith_ops: Recommended runtime knobs for appendix: batch_max_wait_ms=1024, max_batch_tokens=32000, kv_cache=true, quant=8 for Dedicated. Keep 2x burst headroom and configure autoscale to add at least 2 instances per scale event to avoid slow spin-up.
sasha_sales: Thanks team. I'll sync with Orbitary and propose Friday 10:00 PT for the customer-facing run. :thumbsup:
